_about: Copy to tools\render\overlays\melee_themes\layout.json to move the Melee panel's pieces. One file for all three users: the VOD renderer (vod_overlay.py), the OBS scene generator (tools\obs\make_obs_scenes.py) and the Melee dock (name_box). Values = PROTOCOL's layout (the defaults). All positions in 1920x1080 pixels. Leave out what you don't change. See guides\04 Overlay layout map.html and guides\05 Stream PC dock and OBS.html.

_keys.panel_w: panel image scaled to this width at 0,0
_keys.cam: webcam box x, y, w, h (transparent in your panel)
_keys.name_right/name_cy: names are right-aligned to x, centred on y
_keys.name_box: OBS name box w, h (right edge at name_right, centred on name_cy); the dock shortens names that would shrink too far in it
_keys.round_box: OBS round box w, h, centred on round cx/cy
_keys.font_file: your font file in melee_themes\Default\ (VOD renders; missing = Segoe UI Bold)
_keys.obs_font/obs_font_bold: installed font name for the OBS text sources (install your stream font in Windows first)
